motifs.name: central_twisting_pine
motifs.description: Isolate the tall central pine: curved trunk rising from the lower middle to the upper middle, angular branches extending left and right, and clustered pine-needle tufts. Extract only the tree forms, not the calligraphy, hut, rocks, or distant ridge behind it.
must_preserve: dry dark trunk strokes with broken ink edges
angular branch linework crossing the center
short radiating pine-needle clusters
ink-density variations along the trunk and branch joints
small pale gaps between needles and branches

motifs.name: left_tree_bamboo_cluster
motifs.description: Isolate the left-side vegetation group with the leaning dark trunk, sparse brushy foliage, and bamboo leaves around the lower-left slope. Include the visible stems and leaves belonging to this cluster only.
must_preserve: leaning dark trunk with rough dry-brush texture
thin vertical and diagonal bamboo stems
pointed bamboo leaf clusters
loose ink washes around the root area
contrasting heavy black accents and pale gray strokes

must_preserve: sloping roof geometry outlined in dark ink
soft gray roof wash and dry eave strokes
rectangular platform and wall linework

dark black accent patches

pale interior wash

must_preserve: soft layered gray mountain wash
dark broken contour along the ridge crest
pale misty edges fading into the background

motifs.name: bottom_shore_water_lines
motifs.description: Isolate the quiet shoreline and water indication at the bottom: long horizontal ink lines and faint washes beneath the rocks. Do not include the large foreground rocks except for the minimal contact shadows needed to anchor the water.
must_preserve: thin horizontal waterline strokes
slightly uneven dry-brush edges
faint gray wash beneath the shore
minimal dark contact marks at rock bases
wide empty spacing that suggests calm water
